product_constraint: Public OpenFactors stays free of subscriptions and advertising while source open-meteo-era5 uses the free API.

sources.underlying_citation: Hersbach, H., et al. (2023). ERA5 hourly data on single levels from 1940 to present. ECMWF. https://doi.org/10.24381/cds.adbb2d47
sources.zero_precipitation_rule: A source value of 0 is real zero. Only a missing field becomes null.
sources.takedown: Suspend the source. ADR-004 withdraws every published release that includes it and deletes local exports for those release ids. Requests return 404.

sources.license: Transcribed national holiday dates and names, each citing its proclamation. The Gazette website itself is not republished.
sources.attribution: National holidays as proclaimed in the Official Gazette of the Philippines
sources.scope: nationwide regular holidays and special non-working days
sources.unknown_rule: Published is_public_holiday is true or false only. Dates in an incomplete year are omitted from the release.
sources.duplicate_name_rule: Join names with ' | ' in alphabetical order on the single location-date row.
sources.takedown: A corrected proclamation is a new release_id. Withdrawing an old id follows ADR-004.
